item.title: Claude Code 2.4 adds a PreCompact hook and per-subagent tool limits
item.description: Release notes for 2.4: a new hook runs before the conversation is compacted, and a subagent can be stopped after a set number of tool calls.

item.title: Claude Code Max plans move to weekly usage limits with new per-model caps
item.description: From December 1 the five-hour usage window is replaced by weekly caps per model; the monthly price stays the same.
